plugin.name: CustomClockHelper
plugin.title: Custom Clock Helper
plugin.desc: This is a helper plugin for the Custom Clock screen saver applet, it makes it possible to create your own clock styles and modify the existing styles (Controller, Radio, Touch, SqueezePlay)
plugin.creator: Erland Isaksson

plugin.name: SuperDateTimeMacroExtender
plugin.title: SuperDateTime Macro Extender
plugin.desc: Fetches values from one or more JSON endpoints and makes them available to SuperDateTime/Custom Clock via sdtMacroString chaining.
plugin.changes: - add support for local JSON files
plugin.creator: Reiner Paulus
